title: A hearthstone meets billiard mechanics kind of game that I'm dabbling with
author: vnjxk
selftext:
Hey everyone,

Just wanted to share this little project, not sure whether I'll make it fully or not, if anyone is willing to join forces I'll be more than happy to.

it started as a demo for the idea I had to have hearthstone like card game but instead of a simple board the minions and heroes are balls that can be aimed and hit each other multiple times.  
Then I kept telling Deepseek (as I'm a student that can't afford a frontier sub) to make it juicier over and over, it was nice, but wasn't enough so I decided to do a little demo for art styles and that led to the ink painting that you see, which I think is really gorgeous.

comments.author: YouWitchApp
comments.body: This is a really cool concept! I have played a few pool/flick type battler games but playing units from a deck is an interesting twist on it. The art style with ink splats also looks great. I'm looking forwards to see how it goes and playing it haha
